cantó: cantar — he sang (preterite 3rd sg.; la missa cantó 'he sang the mass', i.e. celebrated it; = cantó)
oidme: oír + me — hear me (imperative 2nd pl. oíd + enclitic me, spelt without the accent; Oidme, las escuelas 'hear me, my men'; = oídme)
ifançones: ifançón — minor nobleman, hidalgo (masc. pl.; cuemdes e ifançones 'counts and lesser nobles'; = infanzones)
cometer: cometer — to put forward, propose (infinitive; cometer quiero un ruego 'I wish to put forward a request'; Pidal 'proponer'; = proponer, plantear)
elvira: Elvira — Elvira, one of the Cid's two daughters (doña Elvira, also printed don Elvira; = Elvira)
semejam: semejar + me — it seems to me (present 3rd sg. semeja + enclitic me reduced to -m, as in quem; Semejam el casamiento ondrado 'the match seems to me honourable'; = me parece)
piden: pedir — they ask for (present 3rd pl.; ellos vos las piden 'they ask you for them'; = piden)
mándovoslo: mandar + vos + lo — I order it of you (present 1st sg. mando + enclitic vos + lo, stress accent kept; ellos vos las piden e mándovoslo yo 'they ask you for them and I order it of you'; = os lo mando)
rogadores: rogador — intercessor, one who asks for the bride on another's behalf (masc. pl.; que sean rogadores 'let them be petitioners'; Pidal: the rogador solemnly interceded and asked for the bride in marriage, received her and handed on the authority over her to the husband; = intercesores)
dándoslas: dar + nos + las — give them to us (imperative 2nd pl. dad + nos + las, the d and n of dadnos changed round, dadnos > dandos; dándoslas, mio Çid 'give them to us, my Çid'; = dádnoslas)
hedad: hedad — age (fem. noun; non han grant hedad 'they are not of great age'; = edad)
pequeñas: pequeño — small, little (fem. pl.; de dias pequeñas son 'they are small in days', i.e. young; = pequeñas, jóvenes)
perteneçen: pertenecer — they are suited, are fitting (present 3rd pl.; perteneçen pora mis fijas 'they are suited to my daughters'; = pertenecen, here convienen)
hyo: yo — I (subject pronoun, spelling with h-; hyo las engendré 'I begot them'; = yo)
engendré: engendrar — I begot (preterite 1st sg.; hyo las engendré 'I begot them'; = engendré)
criásteslas: criar + las — you brought them up (preterite 2nd pl. criastes, old -stes ending, + enclitic las; criásteslas vos 'you brought them up'; vos is the separate subject; = las criasteis)
afellas: afe + las — behold them (afe, presentative 'behold, here is' + las; afellas en vuestra mano 'here they are in your hand'; = helas aquí; origin of afe uncertain)
dadlas: dar + las — give them (imperative 2nd pl. dad + las; dadlas a qui quisiéredes vos 'give them to whom you wish'; = dadlas)
levantaron: levantar — they rose, got up (preterite 3rd pl.; se levantaron iffantes 'the Infantes got up'; = levantaron)
camearon: camear — they exchanged (preterite 3rd pl.; camearon las espadas 'they exchanged swords', Pidal 'cambiaron las espadas', in sign of kinship, arms being given as a pledge of friendship; = cambiaron)
dades: dar — you give (present 2nd pl.; quem dades vuestras fijas 'you give me your daughters'; = dais)
dólas: dar + las — I give them (present 1st sg. do + enclitic las, with accent; e dólas por veladas 'and I give them as veiled', i.e. as lawfully wed brides; = las doy)
veladas: velar — veiled, solemnly wed (past part. fem. pl.; por veladas 'as veiled brides', the veiling being part of the church wedding rite, Pidal's el velar 'la ceremonia de las velaciones'; = veladas, casadas por la Iglesia)
caso: casar — I marry off (present 1st sg.; yo las caso a vuestras fijas 'I give your daughters in marriage'; = caso, doy en matrimonio)
ende: ende — of it, from it, thence (adverb/pronoun, Latin inde; ayades ende sabor 'may you have pleasure of it'; = de ello)
afellos: afe + los — behold them (masc. pl.; afellos en vuestras manos ifantes 'here are the Infantes in your hands'; = helos aquí)
aquén: aquén — on this side, here (adverb, the opposite of allén 'beyond'); d' aquén 'from here' (ca d' aquén me torno yo 'for from here I turn back'; = de aquí, de acá)
torno: tornar — I turn back, return (present 1st sg., with reflexive me; me torno yo 'I go back'; = vuelvo)
ayuda: ayuda — help, aid, contribution (fem. noun; en ayuda les do 'I give them as a help'; = ayuda)
metan: meter — they may put in, spend (present subjunctive 3rd pl., purpose; que metan en sus bodas 'that they spend it on their wedding'; Pidal 'empleen, gasten'; = metan, gasten)
bodas: boda — wedding, wedding feast (fem. pl.; en sus bodas 'in their wedding'; = bodas)
dó: dó — where (relative adverb, de + o, = donde; o dó quisiéredes vos 'or wherever you wish')
fueren: seer — they shall be (future subjunctive 3rd pl.; the form is the same as for ir; pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power'; = fueren, tense obsolete, here 'cuando estén')
fet: fazer — do (imperative 2nd pl., short form fet; dellos fet, Campeador 'do with them as you wish, Campeador'; = haced)
casades: casar — you marry off (present 2nd pl.; vos casades mis fijas 'you marry my daughters'; = casáis)
puestas: poner — set, agreed (past part. fem. pl. with son; las palabras son puestas 'the terms are agreed'; = puestas)
omenajes: omenaje — homage, solemn pledge of fealty (masc. pl.; los omenajes dados son 'the pledges are given'; = homenajes)
saliesse: salir — (that) it should come out, rise (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, of the sun; quando saliesse el sol 'when the sun should rise'; = saliese; Pidal restores salie[sse])
tornasse: tornar + se — (that each) should return (imperfect subjunctive 3rd sg. in -sse, with reflexive se; ques tornasse cada uno 'that each should go back'; = se tornase, se volviera)
aquís: aquí + se — then + reflexive (aquí 'at this point, then' + se; aquís metió en nuevas, Pidal 'entonces hizo cosa señalada', 'then he did a notable thing'; = aquí se)
alfaya: alfaya — precious thing, valuable piece (Arabic; d' alfaya 'of great value', Pidal 'de valor'; = alhaja)
metiólos: meter + los — he put them (preterite 3rd sg. metió + enclitic los; metiólos en poder 'he put them in the power of'; = los metió)
evad: evad — behold, here are (presentative, imperative-like 2nd pl.; evad aquí vuestros fijos 'here are your sons'; Pidal 'he aquí'; origin uncertain, cf. evades, afe)
sírvanvos: servir + vos — let them serve you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. sirvan + enclitic vos, n before v kept in spelling, jussive; sírvanvos commo a padre 'may they serve you as a father'; = os sirvan)
guárdenvos: guardar + vos — let them watch over you, keep faith with you (present subjunctive 3rd pl. guarden + enclitic vos, jussive; guárdenvos cum a señor 'let them keep faith with you as a lord'; = os guarden)
devos: dar + vos — may (God) give you (present subjunctive 3rd sg. de + enclitic vos, optative; de[vos] dent buen galardon 'may he give you a good reward for it'; = os dé; the vos is Pidal's restoration)

__broaden__.pues: pues — since, then; pues que 'since' · also pues + future subjunctive 'when, once' (pues fueren en vuestro poder 'when they are in your power')
__broaden__.ques: que + se — who ... themselves (que, relative pronoun, + reflexive se; los ques pudieron escapar 'those who managed to escape'; = los que se pudieron escapar) · also ques — qué + se, 'what … to' (interrogative que + se; non sabent ques far 'they know not what to do', as qué se far at v. 1155; no note in Pidal; = qué hacer) · also fata ques torne 'until he returns' (conjunction fata que + reflexive se; = hasta que se vuelva) · also ques — que + se, conjunction 'that' + reflexive (que otro dia … ques tornasse cada uno 'that next day … each should return'; = que se)
__broaden__.ruego: rogar — I pray, beseech (present 1st sg.; = ruego) · also ruego — request, petition (masc. noun; cometer quiero un ruego 'I wish to put forward a request'; = ruego, petición)
__broaden__.prender: prender — to seize, arrest (infinitive; = prender) · also prender — to take, accept (prender so don 'to take his gift'; = tomar, aceptar)
__broaden__.si: si — if; si + subjunctive alone = 'if only …!' · si non — otherwise, if not (si non, do sopiéredes 'if not, wherever you learn'); si + future subjunctive 'if' (si nos falláredes 'if you find us') · also si — si'nulla = sin + nulla with -n assimilated before n- (si'nulla dubda 'without any fear' (or 'doubt'); = sin ningún miedo, sin ninguna duda) · also si non — 'except, but for' (si non a estos cavalleros 'except these knights'; = salvo) · also si — 'so', optative, = sí, with the present subjunctive in an adjuration (si vos vala el Criador 'so may the Creator help you')
__broaden__.amor: amor — love; por amor de 'for the love of' · also amor — favour, grace of a lord toward his vassal (davos su amor 'he gives you his favour'; del rey he su amor 'I have the king's favour') · also amor — good will, consent (of a vassal to his lord's act; con vuestro amor 'with your good will')
__broaden__.fijos: fijo — son (masc. pl.; fijos dalgo 'sons of something', noblemen; = hijos) · also fijos — children, sons and daughters together (los yernos e las fijas todos vuestros fijos son)
__broaden__.manos: mano — hand (pl.); dar las manos = the handclasp that makes an agreement binding · a las manos 'for the hands' (pidió agua a las manos 'asked for water to wash his hands'); bolver las manos 'to ply the hands', busy eating · also a las manos tomar 'to take by the hand' (a las manos les tomó, Pidal 'los tomó de la mano')
__broaden__.merçed: merçed — mercy, favor; Merçed! 'have mercy, I beg you' (= merced) · also merçed — grace, favour (con la merçed del Criador 'by the grace of the Creator') · also en vuestra merçed 'at your disposal, at your command' (en vuestra merçed somos nos; Pidal 'estamos a vuestro mandar')
__broaden__.gelos: ge + los — them to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + los; = se los) · also ge = 'to them' (que gelos diessen 'that they should give them to them', the knights) · also ge 'from him', dative of separation (gelos reçibe 'he receives them from him')
__broaden__.gelas: ge + las — them for/to him (ge, ancestor of modern se, + las; = se las) · also ge 'to them' (non gelas do yo 'I do not give them to them')
